title: Drop Us A Line - Spas or Spars?
content:
In the second part of our summer compilation, Dan, James, Andy and Anna sift through the correspondence sent in by listeners.

Visit nosuchthingasafish.com for news about live shows, merchandise and more episodes.

If you'd like to write in, you can email podcast@qi.com

Edited by Joe Mayo, Leying Lee and Dan Schreiber

Team includes Tara Dorrell and Ethan Ruparelia
